bearingSource: OSM way 203267860 long axis 74.8°; +X towards the polygonal altar apse (ENE end of the outline), western portico at −X (photos 02, 03, 06, 08)
approximations: Socle (3 m), cornice (14.1 m) and pediment heights and the 30° roof pitch estimated; tower profiles measured on the side view (photo 06, ±0.5 m) and their axial positions ±1 m; north elevation assumed to mirror the photographed south side; relief frieze, capitals and window joinery simplified. The gate bell tower of the west precinct wall is included from the OSM outline (way 203267858: ≈ 103 m west of the church on its axis, turned ≈ 4.5°; a ≈ 10 m square lower stage is assumed within the 10 × 12 m outline) and photos 04, 05 and 09: stage heights (stone stage ≈ 9 m, belfry cornice ≈ 20 m, cross ≈ 35 m) scaled from photo 04; bell roof, bulb dome and lantern in the same dark copper as the church towers; column groups, louvred openings and rustication simplified. The precinct houses (anthracite roofs of a different finish), the small kiosks and the stone-capped enclosure wall are not modelled.

note.ro: Machetă interpretată după fotografiile aeriene: acoperiș în patru ape din cupru cu cele patru turle bulbate îmbrăcate în tablă, porticul de vest și absida poligonală. Înălțimile pereților, panta acoperișului și profilele turlelor sunt estimate; latura nordică este presupusă identică cu cea sudică, iar friza este simplificată. Clopotnița de la poarta de vest a incintei este inclusă: acoperișul în formă de clopot, bulbul și lanterna sunt din același cupru brun închis ca turlele bisericii.
note.hu: A drónfotók alapján értelmezett makett: kontyolt réztető a négy fémlemez-borítású hagymatoronnyal, a nyugati portikusz és a sokszögű apszis. A falmagasságok, a tetőhajlás és a toronyprofilok becsültek; az északi oldalt a délivel azonosnak feltételeztük, a fríz egyszerűsített. A kerítőfal nyugati kapuja feletti harangtorony is szerepel: harang alakú tetője, hagymakupolája és lanternája ugyanabból a sötétbarna rézből készült, mint a templom tornyai.
note.en: Scale model interpreted from the drone photographs: hipped copper roof with the four sheet-metal bulb towers, western portico and polygonal apse. Wall heights, roof pitch and tower profiles are estimated; the north side is assumed to match the south side and the frieze is simplified. The gate bell tower in the west precinct wall is included: its bell roof, bulb dome and lantern carry the same dark brown copper as the church towers.
